scope_statement: Academic open-FPGA PPA estimate; not a commercial device, silicon result, ASIC flow, or signoff.

functional_contract.interface: sha1(clk_i, rst_i, text_i[31:0], text_o[31:0], cmd_i[2:0], cmd_w_i, cmd_o[3:0])
functional_contract.reset: synchronous active-high; held for at least one rising edge before observations
functional_contract.block_protocol: cmd_i=010 starts a first block; cmd_i=110 starts a continuation block; cmd_w_i is a one-cycle strobe; 16 big-endian 32-bit words are supplied in order
functional_contract.observability: text_o and cmd_o must equal the golden reference on every cycle after reset
functional_contract.latency_and_throughput: cycle-exact to the corrected golden seed; no retiming, pipelining, or protocol change is permitted

nist_shavs.program: NIST CAVP Secure Hash Algorithm Validation System, byte-oriented SHA-1 vectors

eqy_yosys_compatibility.reason: Backport the equivalent builtin_ff_cell_types API spelling required by the pinned VTR Yosys revision

formal_and_mutation.candidate_equivalence_semantics: pilot acceptance requires conservative structure-aware sequential equivalence using same-named EQY cut points and public outputs
formal_and_mutation.candidate_scope: cycle-exact, EQY-provable structure-preserving RTL transformations; arbitrary state recoding, retiming and microarchitectural replacement are outside this pilot contract
formal_and_mutation.mutation_coverage_policy: 100% combined verification-stack rejection coverage; publish simulation-detected, formal-only rejected and equivalent counts separately; any inconclusive result is invalid

fpga_architecture.selection_rationale: Freeze a simple non-fracturable single-output LUT6 target so RTL comparisons do not depend on dual-LUT fracturing choices.

upstream_reference_task.relationship: Methodological reference only; its frac1 metrics are not numerically comparable to this frac0 domain.

toolchain.seed_pool_policy: Five exposed search seeds and 64 disjoint fixed certification seeds; certification stops at 64.

activity.active_profile: exactly 60 complete legal blocks at maximum legal rate, followed by 17 inactive tail cycles; no partial block
activity.idle_profile: reset released, inactive interface, active clock
activity.ace_patch_scope: Select the frozen vector input in the VTR driver and correct the pinned ACE EOF loop for newline-terminated traces

scoring.statistical_method: paired log ratios, fixed n=64, Student-t one-sided 95% decision bounds and two-sided 95% reporting intervals
scoring.comparison: five-seed provisional search pool or disjoint fixed 64-seed certification pool
scoring.search_uncertainty: Two-sided 95% Student-t intervals, paired log dispersion and seed wins/ties/losses are descriptive only because the optimizer observes the five search seeds.
scoring.finalist_selection: Freeze each submission by RTL SHA-256, require formal_status=pass before PPA, deduplicate by that identity, rank by recomputed five-seed point score and select at most three finalists.
scoring.champion_rule: A new champion must be the unique certified finalist with direct 64-seed evidence of improvement against the incumbent and every other finalist that also proved improvement against the incumbent.
scoring.acceptance_rule: Composite upper one-sided 95% confidence bound < 1.0 and no primary metric lower one-sided 95% bound > 1.0.
scoring.stopping_rule: Certification ends after exactly 64 seeds; an inconclusive result remains inconclusive and is not extended.

evaluation_tiers.domain_qualification: Once per released contract: NIST Short/Long and Monte Carlo, MCY, power, baseline and clean reproduction.
evaluation_tiers.search: Per proposal: structural and cycle-exact correctness, unbounded EQY and five exposed paired VPR seeds; ranking only.
evaluation_tiers.certification: Selected winner: hard correctness gates, NIST Short/Long and 64 disjoint paired PPA seeds; sole acceptance authority.

scoring.search_score: paired equal-weight geometric PPA mean across five exposed seeds; certified=false and acceptance_decision=null

evaluator_integrity.policy: Candidate acceptance is valid only when the evaluator implementation hashes match this manifest.
